name: create_booking
description: Book an appointment on the business's Cal.com calendar. Only call this after check_availability has confirmed the slot is free AND the caller has explicitly confirmed the date, time, and service back to you.

eventTypeSlug.description: The bookable event type slug for the confirmed service

start.description: ISO 8601 confirmed slot start time — must be a value check_availability returned as free

name.description: Caller's full name, confirmed back letter-by-letter

timeZone.description: Caller's IANA timezone, e.g. Europe/London — never default this

notes.description: Any context from the call worth passing to the business, e.g. service requested, caller's phone number

metadata.description: Idempotency guard — set conversationId to this call's ElevenLabs conversation id so a network retry can't double-book.
